messages:
elaine: 🚀 Quick shoutout — Cirrus AI just went live with EmbedSuite on AWS Marketplace and they chose Redwood Inference for the inference layer. Listing live + onboarding done. :tada:

samir: Huge! any quick metrics from the pilot?

elaine: Pilot summary: 30% lower per-token cost vs the customer's previous self-hosted runtime, 2x throughput for batched chat flows using our continuous batching config. They're using Dedicated with autoscale + prefix cache.

marta: Can we get a short 2-paragraph case study + a quote from their CTO for the external announcement? I can take the writeup.

anna: cc @marketing — please prep a marketplace spotlight & social post. We should highlight: marketplace listing, dedicated capacity, and the EmbedSuite integration.

josh: Heads up — they enabled VPC peering and required our KMS integration for key rotation. Infra ticket was #INF-4021 if anyone needs logs.

deploy-bot: Marketplace listing published: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/B09EXAMPLE — status: active.

nora: Nice! do we have a recommended excerpt for the blog? maybe a short ROI stat and an integration note.

elaine: Draft bullets for the blog: 1) EmbedSuite reduced end-to-end latency by ~35% for search+rerank workflows when using Redwood's prefix cache. 2) Cost efficiency: estimated 30% token-cost reduction after batching/quantization profile. 3) Security: VPC + KMS + audit logs enabled.

samir: For the case study we should include a small architecture diagram. I'll ping design for a simple graphic.

marta: I'll schedule a 30-min quote call with Cirrus' CTO tomorrow at 10am PT. @elaine can you send the invite + consent form?

elaine: On it. Also adding a tiny tech snippet for the engineering blog:

```
redwood_client.create_deployment(
  model="fast-embed-3b",
  variant="quantized-int8",
  autoscale={"min":2, "max":10},
  cache_prefixing=true
)
```

samir: Perfect. One ask from sales: can we note in the marketplace listing that Dedicated reserved capacity options available for enterprise customers?

josh: Added a line to the listing copy. Also filed a follow-up for the renewal playbook to include Cirrus as a reference (sales ref ID: REF-889).

anna: Marketing will draft the blog + social and share for review by EOD. Congrats team! :confetti_ball:

marta: Great work everyone. Small ask — product wants to track any regressions post-launch; can the SRE/observability team add a per-route latency dashboard for the EmbedSuite route?

elaine: Noted. @eng-sre can you add 7-day retention for the route and hook up the rollout to canary?

nora: Will do — tracking ticket created: SRE-2197.

samir: Love this. Closing loop: Cirrus is ready to surface a short customer blurb on their marketing site next week. We'll sync on the quote after the call. :rocket:
